name: Freedom's Future
tagline: Our annual Independence Day celebration for children
imageAlt: A girl bending over a pile of shoes during an outdoor game while children and adults watch from a sandy yard.
description:
Freedom's Future is our Independence Day celebration. It brings together children from orphanages and local churches in underserved communities. Through mentorship sessions, educational and entertainment activities, we keep children in a safe space while teaching them the true value of Liberia's independence.

We also reach out to deliver food, mattresses, school bags, books and stationery directly to orphanages in need.
